# Maryland State Archives

> The Maryland State Archives preserves and provides access to Maryland's government records, historical documents, and vital records through research guides, digital collections, and public services.

MSA serves as the official repository for Maryland state government records and provides comprehensive resources for researchers, government agencies, and the public. The site offers both physical and digital access to records, including a Guide to Government Records, online ordering system, and community archiving resources.

## Research & Collections

- [Getting Started - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/start.html): Research guides and introduction to archives access and government records
- [Maryland State Archives - Guide to Government Records](http://guide.msa.maryland.gov): Comprehensive guide and finding aid to Maryland government records series
- [Maryland State Archives - Guide to Government Records Viewer](https://guide.msa.maryland.gov/pages/viewer.aspx): Records viewer and search interface for Maryland government records guide
- [Maryland Government - Maryland Manual On-Line](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/mdmanual/html/mmtoc.html): Official guide to Maryland government, agencies, and state resources

## Access & Services

- [Visit the Archives - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/visit.html): Visitor information, hours, appointments, and public search room access
- [Hours of Operation - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/hours.html): Operating hours, holiday schedule, and appointment booking information
- [Order Records](https://shop.msa.maryland.gov/orders/pages/orders.aspx): Online ordering system for document copies and vital records from archives
- [Feedback - Maryland State Archives](https://feedback.msa.maryland.gov): Feedback form for reporting issues and submitting user suggestions

## For Government Agencies

- [For Government Agencies - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/govagencies.html): Records management services and resources for Maryland government agencies

## Community Engagement

- [Get Involved - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/involved.html): Volunteer opportunities, donations, internships, and community engagement
- [Community Archiving Resources - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/communityarch.html): Training and resources for community archiving, preservation, and digitization
- [Upcoming Events - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/events.html): Calendar of educational programs, lectures, and community events
- [Donate to the Friends of the Maryland State Archives](https://donations.msa.maryland.gov): Donation platform for Friends of Maryland State Archives nonprofit

## Organization

- [Archives Leadership - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/leaders.html): Leadership team and organizational structure of Maryland State Archives

## Optional

- [Reparative Description Statement - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/reparativedesc.html): Statement on inclusive archival practices and catalog revision standards
- [Land Acknowledgement - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/acknowledgement.html): Institutional acknowledgement of indigenous peoples and tribal relations
- [Access Statement - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/access.html): Statement on records accessibility and digital collections mission
- [Acceptable Use Policy - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/aup.html): Terms of service and acceptable use policy for website and resources
- [Privacy Policy - Maryland State Archives](https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/main/html/privacy.html): Privacy policy and data collection practices for website visitors
